name: Eastern Shore Natural Gas Bridgeville Expansion
monitor_reason: length: no new pipe of 25 km or more
researcher_notes: The Energy Information Administration table for August 2026 (sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 29) lists Eastern Shore Bridgeville Expansion, completed March 1997, 29 miles, 8 inch, docket CP96-97, with 5 million cubic feet per day of added capacity. A 1996 Federal Register notice from the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission describes docket CP96-97 as the Hockessin Expansion. It added one compressor station in New Castle County, Delaware, and 0.89 mile of new 16 inch pipe. It also raised the allowed operating pressure on the existing 28.7 mile Salisbury Lateral from 500 to 590 psig. The 29 miles in the table is that existing lateral, not new pipe. New pipe is under the 25 km rule, so this is a monitor item. The lateral itself is probably already part of the Eastern Shore Gas Pipeline system row P0182. No route researched.
